refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: THe SilikoOperationPower function calculates the result of raising the values in argv to a power determined by starting with argv[argc-2] to the power of argv[argc-1], then raising each preceding value in argv to the running power until it reaches argv[0] and raises it to the running power.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoOperationPower returns a pointer to an object representing the result of the exponentiation operation.

refsection.title: Conformance
refsection.para: The SilikoOperationPower function conforms to Siliko Core’s interface for pure functions and can be installed into a SilikoEngine if wrapped with SilikoPureFunctionCreate.
